$comment: ACC v2 — the agentd v1.3.1 A2A surface. Wire: JSON-RPC 2.0 on POST <listen>/ ; SSE side-streams; proto3 JSON enum spellings (TASK_STATE_*, ROLE_*); RFC 3339 timestamps. Cards at /.well-known/agent-card.json (+ legacy /.well-known/agent.json), unauthenticated. Verified against the binary's capabilities manifest (fixtures/capabilities/agentd-1.3.1-configured.json).

agentd_methods.Pair | interface.pair: the only method an anonymous caller may use (pairing-code login)
agentd_methods.SubscribeToEvents: the observation feed (SSE: hello{seq,resume,resync}/event*/goodbye); -32004 unless interface.enabled

admin_verbs.notes: bare spellings accepted, case-insensitive; lameduck aliases drain; pause/resume take optional {run}; cancel requires {run}

command_ops.workflow_declared: an `a2a` start node with command:<name> registers <name> as an accepted op; its schema: is enforced synchronously at the listener; the run's terminal status completes the A2A task

principals.resolution: pairing token > verified mTLS client cert > constant-time bearer > loopback (if !require_auth); then a2a.principals[] first-match; declaring ANY principal disables loopback-as-operator
principals.principal_fields: match {san|sub|bearer_ref|any}, role, grants (tool-name patterns), labels (travel as agent/acting_for + agent/labels in MCP _meta), quotas {rate, budget}
principals.gates: addressed gates (human.to) are enforced on answer; operator override recorded as operator_override
principals.hot_reload: a2a.principals is reloadable; a2a.listen/tls/bearer are restart-only

error_codes.-32001: task not found (also: not owned — existence not disclosed)
error_codes.-32003: push notifications not supported / authorization refused

tls.listener: https (tls.cert/key[, client_ca]) | loopback http | unix:// (SO_PEERCRED same-uid)
tls.note: A2A TLS material is read once at listener start (upstream ask U2); cert renewal ⇒ rolling restart. The webhook listener DOES rotate per-connection.

message_depth.cross_instance: NOT propagated in the outbound A2A envelope — depth resets at every instance boundary (agentd owns no cross-instance coordination by design). Any cross-agent recursion ceiling is the control plane's to carry in its own command args.
